findings.problem: The hint rules out dumm but not doof, which is just as common, just as casual and also means annoying, so a learner could fairly answer doof.
findings.fix: hint: casual, also annoying; not dumm or doof

back.target: stupid, dumb, silly (casual); also annoying, unfortunate
back.example: That really was a stupid idea.

note: Austria also often says deppert, but blöd is just as common there, so leaving regional as null is fine.
